head.citation-title: Properties and microstructure of carbonated concrete brick through CO2 mineralization with cement kiln exhaust gas
head.abstracts: Copyright © 2025. Published by Elsevier Ltd.This paper investigates the properties and microstructure of concrete bricks produced through accelerated CO2 curing using cement kiln exhaust gas. Based on two years of data from a commercial production line, we demonstrate that the carbonated bricks meet national standard requirements. The compressive strength further increases when stored under appropriate conditions. A comparative analysis with autoclaved bricks reveals the distinct composition and microstructure developed during carbonation. The technology is also evaluated for its eco-efficiency, considering environmental impact, performance, and economic benefits, while its practical applications and advantages are discussed.
